title: Hugras ben Levi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Mishnah Yoma 3:11: he knew a chapter of song and did not want to teach it (in Temple times). In the Gemara there, 35b, when he raised his voice in melody he would put his thumb into his mouth and place his finger between the hairs [of his upper lip], until his brother priests would be thrown backward suddenly. He is mentioned unfavorably.

notes.text: The supplied Yoma 35b locator is retained. Saved Rashi on Yoma 38b explains בין הנימין as between the divided hairs of the upper lip beneath the nose, not between instrument strings. The matching Rashi location is added without erasing the supplied locator.
